# Unisender

UniSender is a simple and easy-to-use service for email and SMS marketing campaigns

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/unisender/.

## Actions

- **Check Email Status** (read-only): Check the delivery status of emails sent via sendEmail method.
- **Create Email Template**: Create a new email template for mass campaigns in UniSender.
- **Create Field**: Create a new custom field for contact data in UniSender.
- **Create List**: Create a new contact list for organizing thematic email campaigns in UniSender.
- **Exclude Contact from Lists**: Remove contacts from specified lists or all lists in UniSender.
- **Export Contacts** (read-only): Export contact data from UniSender lists for synchronization.
- **Get Campaign Status** (read-only): Check the current status of a campaign in UniSender.
- **Get Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve list of campaigns from Unisender within a specified date range.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Get information about a single contact from UniSender.
- **Get Fields** (read-only): Retrieve all custom user-defined fields for contact personalization and data management.
- **Get Lists** (read-only): Retrieve all existing mailing lists associated with the account.
- **Get Messages** (read-only): Retrieve list of all messages with body and attachments.
- **Get Tags** (read-only): Retrieve all custom tags/labels for contact segmentation.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific email template by its ID.
- **Get Templates** (read-only): Retrieve list of all templates with full content including body.
- **Import Contacts (Bulk)**: Bulk import contacts to UniSender with maximum 500 contacts per call.
- **List Messages** (read-only): List all messages without body and attachments.
- **List Templates** (read-only): List email templates without body content.
- **Subscribe Contact to Lists**: Add contacts to one or multiple mailing lists with optional tags and field values.
- **Unsubscribe Contact**: Unsubscribe contacts from mailing lists in UniSender.
- **Check if Contact is in Lists** (read-only): Check if a contact exists in specified mailing lists based on and/or conditions.
- **Create Subscriber Note**: Create a note for a subscriber contact in UniSender.
- **Delete Field**: Remove a custom field from the Unisender system.
- **Delete List**: Permanently delete a contact list from your UniSender account.
- **Delete Subscriber Note**: Delete a subscriber note from UniSender by its ID.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag by its ID and remove it from all associated contacts.
- **Delete Template**: Remove a template from the UniSender account.
- **Get Contact Field Values** (read-only): Retrieve custom field values for a specific contact identified by email address.
- **Get Sender Domain List** (read-only): Retrieve information about sender domains and their DKIM status.
- **Update Email Template**: Update an existing email template for mass campaigns.
- **Update Field**: Modify parameters of an existing custom field in UniSender.
- **Update List**: Update the parameters of an existing contact list in UniSender.
- **Update Subscriber Note**: Update the content of an existing subscriber note in UniSender.
